answer: Make each agent identity lock a copper stake in escrow before it can transact: the deposit is time-locked and slashed if the identity is caught duplicating work or voting twice. A sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately, and the capital stays frozen while an opal-clear public ledger records each stake, so mass creation becomes a visible, expensive bet. From that knoll of locked collateral, honest agents earn fees while attackers bleed escrow with every burned identity.
